verified_scope: Framing, fixed extension origin, shell-parent rejection, fixed methods and sanitized failure replies
Setup approval is required for connect; routine enrolled-window polling/delivery needs no new setup approval
Owner-user registration uses fixed protected app/resources, matches the runtime payload and never opens a vault/keyring
Private Unix bridge to SMS window and DOM/browser fixture completes fresh password/SMS login without returning the code
Wrong capability, wrong window, revoked source, cookie imports and agent transport are refused
limits: Native framing/authorization component and private worker/DOM/browser journey are separate controlled tests, not one complete Chrome-to-XPC acceptance
The current parent policy accepts signed stable Google Chrome only; a positive installed launch remains unverified
Protected resources do not prevent an unrestricted owner-user process from changing Chrome registration or controlling the browser itself
Protected source setup, Chrome Web Store distribution, genuine OS approval, physical devices and private-account QA remain release gates
No Chrome password-vault extraction or continuous Chrome password sync is added
